theta_grid.declared: 2026-11-26, on main after COVID-SHED-SHAPE-01 and COVID-SEED-ASCERTAIN-01, before any DP-UNION-02 cell
theta_grid.lattice: thetas is the runnable half-decade lattice 1e5..1e10, not the scored grid. The zero-inflated shape re-denominates theta again; no scalar conversion is claimed. The lattice span is retained as a broad declared bound because both source representations are normalized to unit peak before theta is fitted and their normalized lifetime areas are the same order, while timing/occurrence heterogeneity prevents an exact conversion. Edge failure is a report, not license to extend after seeing outcomes.

pilot.how: the first 5 selected ascertainment-conditioned seeds of each decade's canary block (scripts/campaign submit --size 5); the same cells the full block would run
pilot.statistic: median over the 5 seeds of positives through day 31 (P31, all seeds, unconditioned), against 634
pilot.reads: only the T3 side of each decade and the saturated edge. The 20-seed dead-row test cannot be read from five pilot cells and is not claimed. No contract leg is scored from pilot cells; they are 5-seed provisional rows.

theta_grid.selection_rule: theta_hi = the lowest pilot decade whose median P31 >= 634; theta_lo = the decade below it. Scored grid = {theta_lo, 3.16*theta_lo, theta_hi, 3.16*theta_hi}, dropping a value above the lattice. Canary = 20 seeds at 3.16*theta_lo. If no pilot decade reaches 634, or the lowest one already does, no grid is declared and that is reported. A pilot median that falls back below 634 above theta_hi is reported and does not move the grid.
